scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode web
scripts.build:desktop: npm run typecheck && vite build --mode desktop
scripts.lint: eslint frontend cli scripts tests/e2e vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend cli scripts tests/e2e README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/migration/feature-inventory.md docs/development/TYPESCRIPT.md docs/performance/TYPESCRIPT-BASELINE.md index.html vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend cli scripts tests/e2e README.md docs/ARCHITECTURE.md docs/migration/feature-inventory.md docs/development/TYPESCRIPT.md docs/performance/TYPESCRIPT-BASELINE.md index.html vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.node.json
